# Opacity

Reads how opaque each splat is so you can find faint or solid areas.

`lfs.opacity` · Input

## How to use

Connect Opacity to Compare to select faint splats.  
Values run from 0 for transparent to 1 for opaque.  

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Opacity | `Opacity` | lfs.float | — | — | Opacity from 0 for transparent to 1 for opaque, before rendering. |
